name: Rice Blast
description: The most destructive fungal disease of rice worldwide, affecting leaves, stems, and panicles. It causes lesions on all above-ground parts and can lead to complete yield loss.
symptoms: Diamond-shaped lesions with gray centers and褐色 margins on leaves
Lesions on leaf sheaths and nodes
Panicle branches breaking at infected nodes
White or tan lesions with dark borders on panicles
causes: Pyricularia oryzae fungus producing abundant spores
Susceptible varieties grown in blast-prone areas
treatments: Apply tricyclazole or isoprothiolane fungicides at booting stage
Use systemic fungicides (triazoles) for neck blast control
Spray at first sign of leaf lesions in the nursery
Apply strobilurin fungicides at panicle initiation
prevention: Reduce nitrogen fertilizer application at heading
Maintain proper plant spacing for air movement
Flood fields continuously to reduce disease pressure
Remove weed hosts and volunteer rice plants
